summary: Phase 5 Damma online RETEST — BOTH iter_15 follow-up fixes are CONFIRMED WORKING. (1) Cross-platform exit Modal: tapping the back chevron (testID='damma-online-back') on web preview now opens a custom React Native Modal (NOT a silent Alert.alert) with title 'الخروج من المباراة' and both action buttons present. Cancel (testID='damma-online-exit-cancel') closes the modal and the URL stays at /game/damma-online?rid={rid}. Backdrop tap (testID='damma-online-exit-backdrop') closes the modal without exiting. Card tap (testID='damma-online-exit-card') correctly invokes event.stopPropagation and keeps the modal open. Confirm (testID='damma-online-exit-confirm') correctly fires router.back() — verified by the console warning 'The action GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator' that appeared because the test direct-loaded /game/damma-online (no history), but the handler is wired correctly and would navigate back in the real lobby→online flow. (2) Chat send: tapping testID='comms-chat-button' opens GameChatSheet; both testID='comms-chat-input' and testID='comms-chat-send' are reachable; typing 'مرحبا من اللاعب' and tapping send clears the input (value==''), the message bubble appears in the chat list, and its parent row has alignSelf='flex-end' + flexDirection='row-reverse' (the rowMine style) confirming the bubble is rendered with fromMe styling on the right. No JS errors fired in the console during chat send (the only console-errors observed were unrelated 401/404 from background calls). Skipped backend testing per request.
